ApplyDataFlowAutoRefresh.description_zh: 为指定数据流动配置自动更新

AttachVscToFilesystems.description_zh: 关联 VSC 设备到文件系统

CreateProtocolService.description_zh: 创建CPFS文件系统的协议服务，创建协议服务过程大约需要5～10分钟

ModifyCpfsAccessPoint.description_zh: 修改 CPFS 智算版 AccessPoint

ModifyDataFlowAutoRefresh.description_zh: 修改数据流动中的自动更新配置

UntagResources.description_en: Removes tags from a file system

UpdateLifecyclePolicy.description_en:
Updates the rules of a lifecycle management policy. Only CPFS for Lingjun is supported.

UpdateLifecyclePolicy uses overwrite semantics. If an optional parameter is left empty, the corresponding field is deleted. To append lifecycle rules, first call the DescribeLifecyclePolicies operation to obtain the current lifecycle rule configurations, append the new lifecycle rule configurations, and then call the UpdateLifecyclePolicy operation to update the lifecycle rule configurations
UpdateLifecyclePolicy.description_zh:
更新一个生命周期管理策略的规则。仅智算 CPFS 支持。

UpdateLifecyclePolicy 是覆盖语义，非必选参数为空则表示删除对应字段。当您需要追加生命周期规则时，请先调用 DescribeLifecyclePolicies 接口获取当前生命周期规则配置，然后追加新的生命周期规则配置，最后调用 UpdateLifecyclePolicy 接口更新生命周期规则配置

UpdateRecycleBinAttribute.description_en: Modifies the retention period of data in the recycle bin of a file system
UpdateRecycleBinAttribute.description_zh: 修改一个回收站中数据的保留时间

UpgradeFileSystem.description_en: Scales up an Extreme NAS file system or a Cloud Parallel File Storage (CPFS) file system
UpgradeFileSystem.description_zh: 扩容极速型NAS文件系统或CPFS文件系统的存储容量
